ManyFaces pilot ratings

Rater demographics and interrater agreement

Code 
library(psych) # ICC, alpha, omega
library(furrr) # run code parallel
library(tidyverse)

# Load custom functions
source("data/custom_functions.R")

Load data

Code 
# Rating data
data_exp <- read_csv("data/manyfaces-pilot-exp_cleaned.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

# Questionnaire data
data_qu <- read_csv("data/manyfaces-pilot-quest_cleaned.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
Code 
data_trait <- data_exp |>
  filter(exp == "attractive" | exp == "dominant"  | exp == "trustworthy"  | exp == "gender-typical"  | exp == "memorable") |>
  mutate(exp = factor(exp, levels = c("attractive", "dominant", "trustworthy", "gender-typical", "memorable"))) |>
  mutate(dv = as.numeric(dv))

data_trait_unstd <- data_exp |>
  filter(grepl("unstd", exp)) |>
  mutate(dv = as.numeric(dv))

data_emo_int <- data_exp |>
  filter(exp == "anger" | exp == "happiness"  | exp == "disgust"  | exp == "surprise"  | exp == "sadness" | exp == "fear") |>
  mutate(dv = as.numeric(dv))

data_emo_cat <- data_exp |> 
  filter(grepl("^em", exp))

Demographic data is available for 1685 of the total of 1909 raters.

Interrater agreement

Standardised trait ratings

ICC

Observed across experiments

Code 
data_trait |> 
  group_by(exp) |> 
  group_map(calc_icc) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

“Corridors of stability” At what sample size (if at all) do ratings reach acceptable reliability of .75 to .90?

Code 
# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Set a stable parallel plan
future::plan(multisession, workers = 3)

# Get unique experiments
experiments <- unique(data_trait$exp)

# Run the function in parallel across experiments
corridor_icc_list <- furrr::future_map(
  experiments,
  function(exp_name) {
    data_subset <- data_trait |> filter(exp == exp_name)
    run_or_load_icc(
      exp_name = exp_name,
      data = data_subset,
      n_raters_seq = seq(10, 100, 10),
      n_iter = 50
    )
  },
  .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
)

# Combine results
icc_corridor <- list_rbind(corridor_icc_list)

# Reset plan to sequential
future::plan(sequential)
Code 
icc2k_corridor_summary <- icc_corridor |> 
  group_by(experiment, n_raters_sampled) |> 
  summarise(
    ICC2_k_median = median(`ICC(2,k)`, na.rm = TRUE),
    ICC2_k_low = quantile(`ICC(2,k)`, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ICC2_k_high = quantile(`ICC(2,k)`, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
Code 
icc2k_corridor_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n_raters_sampled)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ICC2_k_low, ymax = ICC2_k_high), 
              alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey60") +
  # Median ICC(2,k)
  geom_line(aes(y = ICC2_k_median), linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
  # Thresholds: 0.75 grey, 0.9 black
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ experiment) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of raters sampled", 
    y = "ICC(2,k)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
  )

Alpha & omega

Observed across experiments Note on warnings: * “Some items were negatively correlated…”: potentially reflects true inter-rater disagreement; reversing raters not appropriate in this context * “Omega_h… not meaningful”: omega_h is undefined when computing a one-factor solution; omega_t remains valid and is the relevant statistic reported.

Unstandardised trait ratings

ICC

Note: two participants (1x dominant ratings, 1 x trustworthy ratings) responded with only two values but were not caught by our “overly consistent filter”. What do we want to do with them——just drop them here, or exclude them more generally as part of exclusions?

Point of stability (Hehman et al., 2018)

Standardised trait ratings

Code 
set.seed(123)

system.time({
  stability_stats_traits <- calc_stability_stats(data = data_trait,
                                               N = 100,
                                               iterations = 300,
                                               ci_interval = 0.95, ci_method = "percentile",
                                               cos_threshold = 0.5,
                                               save_means = FALSE, # only save if actually needed (huge)
                                               col_map = list(trait = "exp",
                                                              stim_id = "trial_name",
                                                              rating = "dv")) 
})
   user  system elapsed 
245.738   3.468 249.592
Code 
summary_ci_traits <- stability_stats_traits$cis |> 
  group_by(exp, sample_size) |> 
  summarise(ul = mean(ul),
            ll = mean(ll),
            .groups = "drop")

Plot

Code 
stability_stats_traits$pos$label <- paste0("Point of stability\n(N = ", stability_stats_traits$pos$pos, ")")

summary_ci_traits |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_size)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul, fill = exp),
              alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = stability_stats_traits$pos,
             aes(xintercept = pos),
             colour = "black",
             linetype = "solid",
             linewidth = .75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5),
             linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey30",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ exp) +
  xlab("Sample size (N)") +
  ylab("Centered mean ratings") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = paul_tol) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#e8e8e8"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#e8e8e8"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  geom_label(data = stability_stats_traits$pos,
             aes(x = pos + 20, y = 1.6, label = label),
             fill = NA,   
             label.size = NA,
             colour = "black",    
             size = 3.5,
             inherit.aes = FALSE)

Unstandardised trait ratings

Code 
set.seed(123)

stability_stats_traits_unstd <- calc_stability_stats(data = data_trait_unstd,
                                                     N = 100,
                                                     iterations = 300,
                                                     ci_interval = 0.95, ci_method = "percentile",
                                                     cos_threshold = 0.5,
                                                     save_means = FALSE,
                                                     col_map = list(trait = "exp",
                                                                    stim_id = "trial_name",
                                                                    rating = "dv")) 

summary_ci_traits_undstd <- stability_stats_traits_unstd$cis |> 
  group_by(exp, sample_size) |> 
  summarise(ul = mean(ul),
            ll = mean(ll),
            .groups = "drop")

Plot

Code 
# POS labels
stability_stats_traits_unstd$pos$label <- paste0("Point of stability\n(N = ", stability_stats_traits_unstd$pos$pos, ")")

summary_ci_traits_undstd |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_size)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul, fill = exp),
              alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = stability_stats_traits_unstd$pos,
             aes(xintercept = pos),
             colour = "black",
             linetype = "solid",
             linewidth = .75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5),
             linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey30",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ exp) +
  xlab("Sample size (N)") +
  ylab("Centered mean ratings") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = paul_tol) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#e8e8e8"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "#e8e8e8"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  geom_label(data = stability_stats_traits_unstd$pos,
             aes(x = pos + 20, y = 1.6, label = label),
             fill = NA,   
             label.size = NA,
             colour = "black",    
             size = 3.5,
             inherit.aes = FALSE)
